Brief

Video must be original (no reposting another clipper's edit)

Must have a strong hook in first 7 seconds

Vertical 9:16 format

20 -180 seconds in length

Captions burned into video

No copyrighted music unless allowed by the platform.

You need dedicated pages (EXCEPT FOR TWITTER) to Michael Sartain only tagging his main page in bio and reel

FOR ACCEPTANCE:

Must hit minimum 10k views for a payout in 5 days.

Must have Tier 1 Audience and share a screen recording of analytics

List of accepted topics in our guidelines - (no money topics, politics)
All high bot scores will be rejected

CHECK FULL GUIDELINES LINK IN CAMPAIGN

Content requirements

Share audience demographics

Creator requirements

We're looking for skilled short-form video editors who know how to turn podcasts, interviews, and long-form content into engaging, viral-worthy clips.


Our ideal creator understands strong hooks, storytelling, captions, and audience retention. You should have experience creating content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or X.


We're especially interested in creators who understand dating, relationships, masculinity, confidence, and self-improvement content.
